description: Confirm a purchase intent — re-validates price within 1p tolerance, charges via Stripe Connect destination charges (per-seller application fee on item only), and creates the order. May return SCA / payment-action-required / declined errors.

__outcomeForTesting.description: Test-only override of the simulated card outcome. Omit in normal use.

acknowledged_confirmation.description: Set true to acknowledge an intent that requires explicit confirmation. Defaults to false.

confirmation_token.description: Token from the confirmation_required response; must match when acknowledging a confirmation.

intent_id.description: UUID of the purchase intent to confirm.

name: purchase_confirm_intent
title: Purchase confirm intent
